page.overview:
Who is Benay?

Benay was a Human male merchant who sold items of clothing in the Jedi Temple on Tython during the Cold War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic.

Benay first appeared in the 2011 BioWare massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game Star Wars: The Old Republic.
